title: feat: add GPT-6.1 Sol
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `openai/gpt-6.1-sol` on the Azure `gpt-6.1-sol` deployment (Global Standard, 15M TPM), with OpenAI direct as fallback
- Uses OpenAI list rates ($2 / $0.10 cached / $2.50 cache write / $10; >272K $4 / $0.20 / $5 / $15), 1× multiplier, open to Quest Pollen; Azure rates aren't published yet
- Local E2E: text, reasoning effort, tools, streaming, image input, prompt cache, and forced OpenAI fallback; billed amounts match the rates in Tinybird staging
- Leaves GPT-6 Sol and the harness defaults unchanged

gist.headline: A new Sol for the hive
gist.blurb: GPT-6.1 Sol gets a place in the model garden. It takes the Azure path, with a direct OpenAI route ready if needed.
gist.summary: Adds openai/gpt-6.1-sol on Azure’s Global Standard deployment with 15M TPM, direct OpenAI fallback, and access for Quest Pollen users.
gist.impact: Developers get GPT-6.1 Sol for text, reasoning, tools, streaming, and image input, billed at OpenAI list rates starting at $2 input and $10 output per million tokens.
gist.visual_concept: Depict GPT-6.1 Sol as a small warm sun lighting a code garden, with two gentle paths labeled Azure and OpenAI to represent the primary deployment and fallback. Polli tends the new model’s flower; a CRT monitor robot watches the two paths.
